Rashi on Menachot 7b:10:1.english: Rava said: It is taught - That in [the case of] blood, it is not sanctified.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:10:2.english: And he shall dip in the blood, and not wipe - Wiping his finger on the walls of the vessel.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:11:1.english: In the blood - This implies [that there must be a measure of] blood from the outset.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:11:2.english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood that is in the matter - Later [the Gemara] explains what it is.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:12:1.hebrew: הוה אמינא אע"ג דלא קבל שיעור טבילות - כל הזאות מעיקרו, ובלבד שיהא בשעת כל טבילה וטבילה כדי שיעור:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:12:1.english: I would have thought, even though he did not collect the measure of dippings - [That is, for] all the sprinklings from the outset, [it would be valid,] provided that at the time of each and every dipping there is an adequate measure.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:12:2.english: The Merciful One wrote: "In the blood" - Which implies [that there must be the required measure of] blood from the outset.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:14:1.hebrew: למעוטי שירים שבאצבע - שצריך לטבול באצבעו בין כל הזאה והזאה, דהכי משמע: והזה מן הדם האמור בענין למעלה, וטבל הכהן באצבעו בדם - מאותו דם שבכלי שטובל בו יזה כל הזאות, ולא שבאצבע:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:14:1.english: To exclude the remainder on the finger - That he must dip his finger between each and every sprinkling, for this is what it means: "And he shall sprinkle from the blood" [refers to the blood] mentioned earlier in the passage, "and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood" — from that blood in the vessel into which he dips, he shall sprinkle all the sprinklings, and not [from that] which is on the finger.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:1.hebrew: היה מזה - מדם חטאת, כגון פרים ושעירים הנשרפין:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:1.english: He was sprinkling - From the blood of a sin offering, such as the bulls and he-goats that are burned.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:2.hebrew: עד שלא הזה - דאכתי חזי ההוא דם שנפל על הבגד להזאת פנים, חשיב דם:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:2.english: Before he sprinkled - Since that blood that fell on the garment is still fit for the inner sprinkling, it is considered blood.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:3.hebrew: וטעון הבגד כבוס - כדכתיב: ואשר יזה מדמה על הבגד וגו' (ויקרא ו׳:כ׳). ואם משהזה נפל, לא חשיב דם:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:15:3.english: And the garment requires laundering - As it is written: "And when there is sprinkled of its blood upon a garment, etc." (Leviticus 6:20). And if it fell after he sprinkled, it is not considered blood.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:16:1.hebrew: מאי לאו עד שלא גמר - כל ז' הזאות קתני דטעון כיבוס, ואפילו לא נפל אלא משירי אצבע, אלמא כשרין להזאה:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:16:1.english: What, is it not before he completed - [That is, until he has completed] all seven sprinklings, it teaches that it requires laundering, and even if [blood] fell only from the remnants on the finger; evidently, they are fit for sprinkling.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:17:1.hebrew: עד שלא יצתה הזאה מידו - על הפרוכת, נפל על הבגד, טעון כיבוס, דעיקר הזאה נפל עליו. אבל משיצתה הזאה מידו, נפל על הבגד, דהיינו משירים שבאצבע, אין טעון כיבוס:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:17:1.english: Before the sprinkling left his hand - [Toward] the curtain, [if] it fell on the garment, [the garment] requires laundering, for the primary [blood of the] sprinkling fell upon it. But once the sprinkling left his hand, [if] it fell on the garment—that is, from the remainder on the finger—[the garment] does not require laundering.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:18:1.english: [When] he completed sprinkling - [This refers to] the sprinkling of the blood of the red heifer on the Mount of Anointment [the Mount of Olives], toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:18:2.hebrew: לא גמר לא - אלמא שיריים שבאצבע כשרים, ולא צריך קינוח:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:18:2.english: [If] he did not finish, [he does] not - Evidently, the residue on the finger is fit [for sprinkling], and [the finger] does not require wiping.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:19:1.english: And he answers: If he finished, he wipes his entire hand; if he did not finish, he wipes his finger - Between each and every sprinkling.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:1:1.hebrew: ואילו מגביה לא קתני - שיהא אחר מגביה השולחן בשעת סילוק הבזיכין, אלמא מכלי שעל קרקע היו סילוק בזיכין. ובזיכין מתירין את הלחם כקומץ שמתיר את המנחה, דקומץ מיקרי אזכרה ובזיכין נמי מיקרי אזכרה, דכתיב (ויקרא כ״ד:ז׳) והיתה ללחם לאזכרה, וקומץ מתיר שירים לאכול, דכתיב (שם ב) והנותרת מן המנחה וגו' מאשי ה':
Rashi on Menachot 7b:1:1.english: And yet [that one] raises is not taught - That another [priest] should raise the Table at the time of the removal of the bowls, which indicates that the removal of the bowls was from a vessel that rests upon the ground. And the bowls permit the bread [to be eaten], just as the handful permits the meal offering [to be eaten]; for the handful is called a memorial portion, and the bowls are also called a memorial portion, as it is written (Leviticus 24:7): "That it may be to the bread for a memorial portion," and the handful permits the remainder to be eaten, as it is written (ibid. 2:3): "And that which is left of the meal offering etc. of the offerings of the Lord made by fire."

Rashi on Menachot 7b:20:1.hebrew: בשלמא גמר מקנח כל ידו בגופה של פרה - שהרי פרה לפניו נשרפת לאחר שיורד מן ההר, דכתיב (במדבר י״ט:ה׳) ושרף את הפרה לעיניו:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:20:1.english: Granted, [if] he completed, he wipes his entire hand on the body of the heifer - For the heifer is burned before him after he descends from the mount [of Olives], as it is written (Numbers 19:5): "And the heifer shall be burned in his sight."

Rashi on Menachot 7b:20:2.english: But his finger - Between each and every sprinkling.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:20:3.english: With what does he wipe - For would he descend from the Mount of Olives between each and every sprinkling to wipe [his finger] on the body of the heifer?

Rashi on Menachot 7b:21:1.hebrew: בשפת מזרק - והיינו דקרי למזרקין כפורי זהב בספר עזרא, על שם שמקנח ידו בו, כדאמרינן במס' גיטין (דף נו.) גבי (נבוזר אדן): וכפר ידיה בההוא גברא:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:21:1.english: On the rim of the basin - And this is why [Scripture] calls the basins keforei zahav [golden basins] in the Book of Ezra, on account of [the priest] wiping his hand on it, as we say in Tractate Gittin (page 56a) regarding (Nebuzaradan): "And [He wants] to wipe His hands on that man."

Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:1.english: And did Rabbi Elazar say this - That even in [the case of] blood, it is not sanctified in halves.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:2.hebrew: חביתי כהן גדול - עשירית האיפה שמקריבין בכל יום, ועל שם מחבת קרי לה חביתים, דכתיב (ויקרא ו׳:י״ד) על מחבת בשמן תעשה:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:2.english: The High Priest's griddle-cakes - [This is] the tenth of an ephah that they offer every day, and after the name of the griddle [machavat], it is called chavitim, as it is written (Leviticus 6:14): "On a griddle it shall be made with oil."

Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:3.hebrew: אינה לחצאין - שאם נתן חצי עשרון בכלי זה וחציו בכלי זה, לא קידש ויצאה לחולין:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:3.english: It is not in halves - That if one placed half an issaron in this vessel and half of it in that vessel, it is not sanctified, and it goes out to non-sacred status.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:22:4.english: That it is offered in halves - Half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:2:1.english: He cited the order of the services - And lifting [the Table] is not one of the significant services.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:4:1.hebrew: מקדשין מנחה - כשמביאה מביתו, נותנה בכלי שעל גבי קרקע:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:4:1.english: One sanctifies a meal offering - When one brings it from his house, he places it into a vessel that is upon the ground.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:4:2.hebrew: שכן מצינו בסידור בזיכין - שמסדר (על) הלחם, שהוא שירים, ובזיכין, שהן קומץ, על השולחן שעל גבי קרקע, דהיינו דומיא דמנחה כשמביאה מביתו, דמעורבין יחד הקומץ והשירים:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:4:2.english: As we find regarding the arrangement of the bowls - For one arranges (upon) the bread, which is the remainder, and the bowls [of frankincense], which are the handful, upon the Table that is on the ground; that is, analogous to a meal offering when one brings it from his house, in that the handful and the remainder are mixed together.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:5:1.hebrew: קידוש קומץ מאי - דלא אשכחן בבזיכין כשהוא מסלקן, דהיינו קמיצה, שיהא נותנו לשום כלי, אלא מיד מקטירו, הלכך ליכא למפשט קידוש קומץ מהתם:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:5:1.english: What is [the law regarding] the sanctification of the handful - For we do not find regarding the bowls [of frankincense], when he removes them — which corresponds to the removal of the handful — that he places it into any vessel; rather, he immediately burns it. Therefore, one cannot resolve [the question of] the sanctification of the handful from there.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:5:2.hebrew: מדם - מקבלת [דם], דכתיב (שם א): והקריבו בני אהרן, ואמרינן בתורת כהנים: והקריבו זו קבלת הדם. וקידוש קומץ כנגד ארבע עבודות של דם: קמיצה כנגד שחיטה, וקידוש קומץ כנגד קבלה, והולכה כי הולכה, והקטרה כנגד (ד' עבודות של דם קמיצה כנגד שחיטה וקידוש כנגד) זריקה:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:5:2.english: From blood - From the collection of [the blood], as it is written (ibid. 1:5): "And Aaron's sons shall present [the blood]," and we say in Torat Kohanim: "'And they shall present' — this is the collection of the blood." And the sanctification of the handful corresponds to the four services of blood: taking the handful corresponds to slaughter, and the sanctification of the handful corresponds to collection, and conveying is like conveying, and burning corresponds to (the four services of blood: taking the handful corresponds to slaughter, and sanctification corresponds to) sprinkling.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:6:1.english: And did Rava say this - That we derive [it] from blood.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:6:2.hebrew: לילף מדם - ודם לא קידש לחצאין: אם קבל שיעור הזאות דדם אשם מצורע או דם פרים ושעירים הנשרפין בשני כלים, לא עשה כלום, כדאמרינן לקמן:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:6:2.english: Let him derive from blood - And blood is not sanctified in halves: if one collected the requisite measure of sprinklings of the blood of a leper's guilt-offering or the blood of bulls and he-goats that are burned into two vessels, he has done nothing, as [the Gemara] says later.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:6:3.hebrew: מההיא - דודאי אינו קידוש, דמדם ילפינן:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:6:3.english: From that - That it is certainly not a valid sanctification, as we derive [it] from blood.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:7:1.english: Sanctified - [This refers to] the water of purification.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:7:2.english: Enough for sprinkling - Enough for him to dip the tips of the stalks [of hyssop] and sprinkle.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:7:3.hebrew: לא קידש - ואע"פ שחזר ועירבו לאחר קידוש, נתינת מים על האפר:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:7:3.english: He has not sanctified [it] - And even though he went back and combined them after the sanctification, [i.e.,] the placing of the water on the ashes.

Rashi on Menachot 7b:8:1.hebrew: בדם מאי - אם קיבל מדם שעירים ופרים הנשרפים, שטעונין הזייה, וקיבל שיעור ג' הזאות בכלי זה ושיעור ד' הזאות בכלי זה, מהו:
Rashi on Menachot 7b:8:1.english: With regard to blood, what [is the halakha] - If one collected from the blood of the he-goats and bulls that are burned, which require sprinkling, and he collected the measure of three sprinklings in this vessel and the measure of four sprinklings in that vessel, what is [the halakha]?

Tosafot on Menachot 7b:18:1.english: [When] he finished sprinkling - This is a mishna in tractate Parah.

Tosafot on Menachot 7b:18:2.hebrew: מקנח ידו בגופה של פרה - שהרי פרה לפניו נשרפת לאחר שיורד מן ההר, דכתיב ושרף את הפרה לעיניו, כך פי' רבינו שלמה. ונראה דלא מייתי קרא אלא משום דכתיב בסיפיה ואת דמה ישרוף, אלמא דמה טעון שריפה, ולפיכך מקנח ידו בגוף הפרה; ופי' הקונטר' מגומגם:
Tosafot on Menachot 7b:18:2.english: He wipes his hand on the body of the heifer - “For the heifer is burned before him after he descends from the mount [of Olives], as it is written: ‘And the heifer shall be burned in his sight’ (Numbers 19:5)” — thus explained Rabbeinu Shlomo [Rashi]. And it appears that [the Gemara] cites the verse only because it is written at its end, “and its blood... he shall burn,” which shows that its blood requires burning, and therefore he wipes his hand on the body of the heifer [so that the blood will be burned with it]; and the explanation of the Kunteres [Rashi] is problematic.

Tosafot on Menachot 7b:20:1.hebrew: אלא אצבעו במאי מקנח - כאן פי' הקונטרס: לפי שהיה מזה מדמה בהר המשחה אל פני אהל מועד, ופרה לפניו נשרפת לאחר שיורד מן ההר; והיאך היה יורד בין כל הזאה והזאה מהר המשחה לקנח בגוף הפרה? ובזבחים בפ' דם חטאת (זבחים דף צג:) פירש, שלא היה יכול לקנח אצבעו בגוף הפרה, שלא יתלכלך אצבעו בנימין, דהכי נמי חיישינן בנימין בפ' כל כתבי (שבת קטז:) גבי מפשיט את הפסח עד החזה. ולפי' הקונטרס דהכא, אין להקשות מהא דאמרינן בפרק בתרא דזבחים (דף קיג.) דשחיטה והזאה כנגד פתחו של היכל; דבשביל כך לא היו במקום אחד, אלא שתיהן היו מכוונות כנגד פתחו של היכל:
Tosafot on Menachot 7b:20:1.english: Rather, with what does he wipe his finger - Here Rashi explained: Because he would sprinkle from its blood on the Mount of Anointment [the Mount of Olives] toward the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the heifer is burned before him [only] after he descends from the mountain; and how could he descend between each and every sprinkling from the Mount of Anointment to wipe [his finger] on the body of the heifer? And in Zevachim, in the chapter [entitled] "Dam Chatat" (Zevachim 93b), he explained that he could not wipe his finger on the body of the heifer lest his finger become soiled with hairs, for we are likewise concerned about hairs in the chapter [entitled] "Kol Kitvei" (Shabbat 116b) regarding one who flays the Pesach [offering] up to the breast. And according to Rashi's explanation here, one should not raise a difficulty from that which we say in the last chapter of Zevachim (113a), that the slaughter and the sprinkling [must be] opposite the entrance of the Sanctuary; for they were not in the same place on account of that, but rather both of them were aligned opposite the entrance of the Sanctuary.

Tosafot on Menachot 7b:4:1.hebrew: שכן מצינו בסילוק בזיכין - הא מילתא דלא כרבי חנינא, דאמר לקמן (מנחות דף ח.): לא זו קדושה בלא זו, דאיהו לא יליף מילתא ממילתא:
Tosafot on Menachot 7b:4:1.english: As we find regarding the removal of the bowls - This matter is not in accordance with Rabbi Chanina, who says below (Menachot 8a): "Neither is this [substance] sanctified without that [one]," for he does not derive one matter from another matter.

Tosafot on Menachot 7b:6:1.hebrew: הדר ביה רבא - מהך סברא, דקם רבא בשיטתא דרב נחמן רביה:
Tosafot on Menachot 7b:6:1.english: Rava retracted - [He retracted] from that reasoning, so that Rava stood in the position of Rav Nachman, his teacher.
